card.name: Linking words before treatment or administration verbs
card.fires_on: Small linking words (were, to, that, comma, when) right after an animal or drug subject in study descriptions, just before a verb about treating or administering.

modes.label: were after subject
modes.description: The word 'were' after animals or drugs, leading into 'treated' or 'administered'.
modes.example: When males<< were>> treated prior to mating with untreated females,

modes.label: comma after animal studies
modes.description: A comma after an opening phrase about animal studies, before a statement of the drug's effect.
modes.example: In animal studies<<,>> everolimus caused embryo-fetal toxicity

modes.label: that or to after study verb
modes.description: A joining word after a verb such as 'shown' or 'adding' in research summaries.
modes.example: Preclinical studies have shown<< that>> the combination of benzodiazepines

card.plain: It marks the small joining word in animal and lab study sentences just before the text says what was given or done.
